title: CollaborationContextBinding
description: Canonical collab.v1 representation of one context_snapshots row. A review binding is identical to the pcs.v2 envelope on read_set, watermarks, profile_ref and content_hash; a consult binding has trigger_ref null, envelope_version collab.v1, and is rejected by the pcs.v2 reader. Collaboration references live in collab_source_refs, never in read_set.

envelope_version.description: review keeps the pcs.v2 envelope; consult is collab.v1. The coupling with context_kind is semantic (R12).

trigger_ref.description: Review trigger event; must be null for consult.

state_revision.description: Cognitive state revision at assembly. Collaboration metadata never advances it.

profile_ref.description: Pinned profile record used by assembly. v1 assembly always writes one; null is legal only for the empty-read-set variant and never used to hide a missing profile.

read_set.description: Records read by assembly. Only RecordRefs; EventRefs and collaboration refs are never read-set entries.

collab_source_refs.description: Collaboration inputs/artifacts rendered into this Context. Empty for a pure pcs.v2 review.
